sample_unit: information sources (51 online resources and 4 LLM responses)

links.outcome: Readability grade level and Flesch Reading Ease of LLM and online RCPD patient materials
links.effect: Average readability of online material and LLM responses was 11th-12th grade level; Flesch Reading Ease lowest for LLMs, especially DeepSeek-V2.5 (24.21).
links.quote: The average readability level of the online material and the LLM responses was at the 11th-12th grade level.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM and online patient education materials versus recommended level
links.effect: Both online and LLM-generated RCPD materials exceeded recommended readability levels (11th-12th grade average).
links.quote: This study revealed that both online and LLM-generated materials on RCPD exceeded the recommended readability levels.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated patient education materials for RCPD on readability, understandability, and quality, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
